description: A source-linked terminal research notebook for Indian equities.

novel_features.name: Peer evidence matrix
novel_features.description: Compare live peer financial, ownership, and operating evidence in one unit-aware matrix.

novel_features.name: Portfolio/watchlist review queue
novel_features.description: Join current holdings or watchlist names with upcoming results, events, reports, and alerts.

novel_features.name: Financial-period change report
novel_features.description: Emit deterministic row-level changes between two server-returned financial periods.

novel_features.name: Ownership-and-fundamentals cross-check
novel_features.description: Align same-period ownership movements with financial and cash-flow changes.

novel_features.name: Results-to-document chain
novel_features.description: Connect a result or event to report, concall, and validated source-document metadata.

novel_features.name: Screener audit output
novel_features.description: Return the exact native query, matched fields, result page, and request provenance (use --explain).

novel_features.name: Sector operating-context pack
novel_features.description: Bundle dated company, sector, macro, and raw-material observations without a synthetic verdict.

novel_features.name: Portfolio concentration and quality table
novel_features.description: Join live portfolio weights with public company quality evidence and explicit unavailable states.

novel_features.name: Timeline-to-source lookup
novel_features.description: Resolve timeline items to normalized event, report, and document metadata while preserving cursors.

novel_features.name: Authenticated capability probe
novel_features.description: Report public, authenticated, empty, blocked, expired, or changed-shape status per safe GET endpoint.

novel_features.name: Raw-material sensitivity table
novel_features.description: Place current raw-material observations beside live operational and revenue-mix data.
